# Return an error if the user tries to list a go source file directly in $GKROOT/src.
# Tests golang.org/issue/36587

env GKROOT=$WORK/goroot
env GKPATH=$WORK/gopath

go env GKROOT
stdout $WORK[/\\]goroot

# switch to GKROOT/src
cd $GKROOT/src

# In module mode, 'go list ./...' should not treat .go files in GKROOT/src as an
# importable package, since that directory has no valid import path.
env GK111MODULE=on
go list ...
stdout -count=1 '^.+$'
stdout '^fmt$'
! stdout foo

go list ./...
stdout -count=1 '^.+$'
stdout '^fmt$'
! stdout foo

go list std
stdout -count=1 '^.+$'
stdout '^fmt$'

! go list .
stderr '^GKROOT/src is not an importable package$'

# In GKPATH mode, 'go list ./...' should synthesize a legacy GKPATH-mode path —
# not a standard-library or empty path — for the errant package.
env GK111MODULE=off
go list ./...
stdout -count=2 '^.+$' # Both 'fmt' and GKROOT/src should be listed.
stdout '^fmt$'
[!GKOS:windows] stdout ^_$WORK/goroot/src$
[GKOS:windows] stdout goroot/src$ # On windows the ":" in the volume name is mangled

go list ...
! stdout goroot/src

go list std
! stdout goroot/src

go list .
[!GKOS:windows] stdout ^_$WORK/goroot/src$
[GKOS:windows] stdout goroot/src$

# switch to GKPATH/src
cd $GKPATH/src

# GK111MODULE=off,GKPATH
env GK111MODULE=off
go list ./...
[!GKOS:windows] stdout ^_$WORK/gopath/src$
[GKOS:windows] stdout gopath/src$

go list all
! stdout gopath/src

-- $WORK/goroot/src/go.mod --
module std

go 1.14
-- $WORK/goroot/src/foo.go --
package foo
-- $WORK/goroot/src/fmt/fmt.go --
package fmt
-- $WORK/goroot/src/cmd/README --
This directory must exist in order for the 'cmd' pattern to have something to
match against.
-- $GKPATH/src/foo.go --
package foo
